preseason_hypothesis: Willis remains the clear starter throughout camp and the preseason
confirming_evidence: dominant first-team share; starts preseason dress rehearsal; Ewers works primarily with backups
disconfirming_evidence: Ewers receives sustained first-team work; Willis injury or role demotion

preseason_hypothesis: Designed rushing will be a weekly component rather than only emergency scrambling
confirming_evidence: read-option keepers; quarterback power; red-zone designs; called movement runs
disconfirming_evidence: carries arise almost entirely from broken pass plays

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will ask Willis to stay in progression more often than Green Bay's limited package required
confirming_evidence: intermediate timing throws; outlet use; low avoidable-sack rate under pressure
disconfirming_evidence: repeated early scrambles; missed outlets; late sacks after initial read

preseason_hypothesis: The passing menu will combine catch-and-run concepts with calculated intermediate and deep shots
confirming_evidence: targets at all levels; play-action explosives; middle-field completions
disconfirming_evidence: almost all attempts are screens quick game or scramble drill

preseason_hypothesis: Achane will retain the clear lead role and majority of high-value backfield snaps
confirming_evidence: first-unit carries; two-minute snaps; routes; inside-10 opportunities
disconfirming_evidence: series rotation; Gordon dominates scoring work; Wright earns independent drives

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will preserve Achane receiving value through designed targets even if Willis checks down less
confirming_evidence: screens; option routes; slot or wide alignment; first-read targets
disconfirming_evidence: low route share and targets limited to broken plays

preseason_hypothesis: Gordon will remain the primary short-yardage threat while Wright functions as Achane's direct relief
confirming_evidence: Gordon inside-5 and short-yardage work; Wright substitutes on Achane series
disconfirming_evidence: Wright earns standalone drives; Achane dominates goal line; Gordon role contracts

preseason_hypothesis: Washington will have the highest receiver route floor and meaningful third-down work
confirming_evidence: starts in 11 personnel; stays on field in two-minute; leads third-down routes
disconfirming_evidence: leaves field in core packages; Coleman or another receiver takes slot and third-down role

preseason_hypothesis: Tolbert and Atwell will open as the leading outside pair while Douglas develops
confirming_evidence: first-unit outside routes; stable 11-personnel snaps
disconfirming_evidence: Douglas or another receiver consistently displaces either veteran

preseason_hypothesis: Dulcich will lead Miami tight ends in routes while Kacmarek and Sims handle more blocking
confirming_evidence: third-down and two-minute routes; slot alignment; first-read targets
disconfirming_evidence: Dulcich stays in protection or rotates off while another tight end wins routes

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will use multiple-tight-end personnel to disguise runs and play action
confirming_evidence: regular 12 personnel with both run and pass outcomes; motion across formation
disconfirming_evidence: 11 personnel overwhelmingly dominates; tight ends reveal play type

preseason_hypothesis: Paul-Proctor-Brewer-Savaiinaea-Jackson will be the opening five if healthy
confirming_evidence: repeated first-unit combination; Jackson returns; no position shuffling
disconfirming_evidence: Jackson absence persists; Proctor moves to tackle; another guard wins a job

preseason_hypothesis: The line will support outside zone inside zone and gap concepts without telegraphing by personnel
confirming_evidence: multiple concepts from same grouping; successful combination blocks
disconfirming_evidence: run menu narrows; substitutions strongly predict concept

preseason_hypothesis: Continuity will improve protection enough to sustain intermediate and deep concepts
confirming_evidence: manageable pressure rate; clean handling of stunts; limited chip help
disconfirming_evidence: interior leakage; repeated stunt errors; tight ends or backs routinely kept in

preseason_hypothesis: Extensive motion will create leverage without unacceptable assignment and snap-point errors
confirming_evidence: clean motion timing; low pre-snap penalty rate; explosives created after motion
disconfirming_evidence: repeated false starts; illegal shifts; wrong alignments; abandoned motion

preseason_hypothesis: Proctor's run blocking will translate faster than his pass protection during the move from college left tackle to NFL left guard
confirming_evidence: movement and displacement across concepts; limited run-assignment errors; more pass than run losses
disconfirming_evidence: equal or greater run-game difficulty; early removal from first unit

preseason_hypothesis: A return to the right side will produce a material second-year improvement
confirming_evidence: cleaner hand placement; fewer immediate pressures; stable first-unit snaps
disconfirming_evidence: continued interior leakage; Salyer takes sustained first-unit work

preseason_hypothesis: Paul and Proctor will become Miami's preferred designed-run combination
confirming_evidence: above-baseline run frequency and yards before contact to the left; repeated successful combinations
disconfirming_evidence: balanced direction; right side more efficient; formation tips the run

preseason_hypothesis: Jackson's availability is the largest tackle-related swing variable
confirming_evidence: full participation; stable starting five; limited chip help
disconfirming_evidence: recurring absence; backup tackle targeted; route menu contracts

preseason_hypothesis: Brewer will keep the young interior functional but his absence would create an offense-wide downgrade
confirming_evidence: clean communication and combination blocks with Brewer; visible decline in any missed reps
disconfirming_evidence: reserve center maintains operation without added help or errors
review_trigger: any Brewer absence or reserve-center series

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will use movement passes play action and Willis's mobility to manage conventional pass-protection risk
confirming_evidence: boots and keepers alter rush; play action creates time; conventional sets remain selective
disconfirming_evidence: static dropback volume stays high; mitigation fails to reduce quick pressure

preseason_hypothesis: Interior pressure will be a larger early threat than edge pressure
confirming_evidence: guard losses and exchange errors drive pressure; tackles hold without routine help
disconfirming_evidence: edge losses dominate; young guards stabilize quickly
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season starts

preseason_hypothesis: Brewer will remain Miami's primary protection organizer
confirming_evidence: Brewer sets points and directs adjustments; adjacent blockers follow his calls; operation changes when he exits
disconfirming_evidence: Willis visibly controls most protection changes; another lineman directs the unit

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will give Willis more pre-snap protection responsibility than Green Bay used in his limited starts
confirming_evidence: Mike declarations; protection checks; responses to late rotation; multiple answers from the same call
disconfirming_evidence: static calls; no visible checks; center or sideline controls nearly all adjustments

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will provide identifiable hot answers against overload and simulated pressure
confirming_evidence: ball replaces blitz; receiver and quarterback identify the same answer; few free-rusher sacks
disconfirming_evidence: available hot routes are missed; repeated unblocked rushers create holds scrambles or sacks
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season starts

preseason_hypothesis: Movement passes will mitigate pressure without becoming the majority of Miami's successful passing plays
confirming_evidence: boots and keepers create explosives while conventional dropbacks remain functional
disconfirming_evidence: successful passing depends overwhelmingly on moved launch points or broken structure

preseason_hypothesis: Willis will preserve designed outlets rather than replacing them with early scrambles
confirming_evidence: timely throws to backs and tight ends; climbs and resets before escaping; low avoidable-sack rate
disconfirming_evidence: missed outlets; clean-pocket exits; scrambles begin before the progression fails
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season starts

preseason_hypothesis: Five-man protection will sustain receiver and tight-end route participation
confirming_evidence: backs and tight ends release; five eligible receivers enter patterns; intermediate and deep concepts remain available
disconfirming_evidence: routine chips delayed releases or max protection materially reduce routes

preseason_hypothesis: Slowik will counter effectively when opponents change pressure tactics after halftime
confirming_evidence: second-half protection or concept changes reduce repeat pressure; offense restores valid answers
disconfirming_evidence: same pressure family creates repeated second-half losses; route menu contracts without a counter
review_trigger: each of first four regular-season games

preseason_hypothesis: Willis's deep outside accuracy will remain above league average after his Miami sample expands
confirming_evidence: accurate placement and positive efficiency on at least 20 charted deep outside attempts
disconfirming_evidence: completion and efficiency fall below league average or explosives depend mainly on coverage busts
review_trigger: after 20 charted Miami deep outside attempts

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will expand Willis's intermediate-middle usage beyond his Green Bay baseline without an efficiency collapse
confirming_evidence: more than 4% of attempts target the middle at 11-20 air yards with sustainable accuracy and positive results
disconfirming_evidence: usage remains near the reported 4% Green Bay rate or added attempts produce repeated turnover-worthy plays and stalled drives

preseason_hypothesis: Willis's descriptive sack rate will decline materially from his 11.0% Green Bay rate
confirming_evidence: sacks remain below 8% of attempts plus sacks across representative dropbacks
disconfirming_evidence: rate remains at least 10% or falls only because Miami removes eligible routes and conventional dropbacks

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will remain efficient when game script requires at least 30 Willis pass attempts
confirming_evidence: positive passing efficiency; manageable sacks and turnovers; functional second-half answers in a 30-attempt game
disconfirming_evidence: efficiency and drive success collapse as volume rises or Miami cannot preserve a full route menu
review_trigger: first game with at least 30 Willis pass attempts

preseason_hypothesis: Willis's fumble rate will not rise as his dropback and scrambling volume expands
confirming_evidence: secure carriage and exchanges with no more than one fumble per 100 combined dropbacks and rushes
disconfirming_evidence: multiple exchange or extension fumbles and a rate above the registered threshold
review_trigger: after 100 combined Miami dropbacks and rushes

preseason_hypothesis: Willis will remain effective after opponents remove first-read deep and outside concepts
confirming_evidence: timely second-progression and middle-field completions; outlet use; sustained drives after coverage adjustments
disconfirming_evidence: repeated holds scrambles sacks or forced throws when the preferred outside concept is capped
review_trigger: each of first four regular-season games

preseason_hypothesis: Kacmarek will become Miami's core attached tight end without being restricted to obvious run situations
confirming_evidence: first-unit snaps in both run and pass calls; reliable assignments; routes released from attached alignments
disconfirming_evidence: package-only work; substitutions reveal run tendency; pass-protection errors limit snaps
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season starts

preseason_hypothesis: Dulcich's late-2025 receiving efficiency will remain useful when his route volume expands
confirming_evidence: healthy first-unit participation; routes on at least 60% of team dropbacks; targets at multiple depths and alignments
disconfirming_evidence: recurring absence; route rate below 50%; efficiency depends on busted coverage or tiny samples
review_trigger: after two games with at least 15 team dropbacks

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will release two or more tight ends into routes often enough for 12 personnel to threaten both run and pass
confirming_evidence: two receiving releases from 12 or 13 personnel; play action and dropback pass from the same looks
disconfirming_evidence: one tight end routinely protects or chips; multiple-tight-end personnel overwhelmingly produces runs

preseason_hypothesis: Miami's tight-end substitutions and alignments will not reliably reveal run or pass intent
confirming_evidence: each primary tight end aligns in multiple locations and participates in both run and pass outcomes
disconfirming_evidence: Dulcich entry predicts pass while Kacmarek or Sims entry predicts run with a strong tendency

preseason_hypothesis: Traore will earn an active-game role through special teams before receiving a stable offensive workload
confirming_evidence: core special-teams snaps; game-day active status; small distinct receiving package
disconfirming_evidence: inactive status; assignment or blocking issues; no core special-teams role
review_trigger: each preseason game and final roster decisions

preseason_hypothesis: Tolbert will retain the X role and a full route share when Miami reduces to two receivers
confirming_evidence: first-unit X alignment; stays on field in 12 and 21 personnel; red-zone and back-shoulder targets
disconfirming_evidence: Douglas or Bell takes two-receiver routes; Tolbert rotates by package or lacks targets
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season starts

preseason_hypothesis: Washington's 2026 receiving role will expand materially beyond short and designed touches
confirming_evidence: intermediate and deep routes; progression targets; outside alignment; yards per catch rises with stable routes
disconfirming_evidence: targets remain concentrated behind the line or shallow; Coleman and tight ends reduce routes
review_trigger: after 30 charted routes and each preseason game

preseason_hypothesis: Atwell will earn full Z routes rather than functioning primarily as a vertical and motion package player
confirming_evidence: stays on field across personnel and situations; intermediate routes; blocking trust
disconfirming_evidence: limited package snaps; frequent rotation; routes concentrated on clear-outs and deep shots
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season starts

preseason_hypothesis: Douglas will earn a core outside role during his rookie season
confirming_evidence: first-unit outside routes; wins against press; targets between the 20s plus red-zone work
disconfirming_evidence: assignment or catch errors; cannot separate; remains a situational red-zone player

preseason_hypothesis: Bell will progress from active/NFI to meaningful 2026 offensive work without a rushed return
confirming_evidence: full practice participation; contact tolerance; repeated team routes; active-game status
disconfirming_evidence: rehab setbacks; reserve placement; limited individual work without team progression
review_trigger: every official participation and transaction update

preseason_hypothesis: Coleman will earn an active role through returns and independent slot work
confirming_evidence: first-wave punt returns; third-down or two-minute routes; designed targets distinct from Washington
disconfirming_evidence: reserve return placement; no core teams role; offensive snaps duplicate Washington only
review_trigger: each preseason game and final roster decisions

preseason_hypothesis: Run-blocking execution will determine Miami's two-receiver rotation
confirming_evidence: same receivers stay on field for run and pass; successful edge assignments; play-action routes follow run looks
disconfirming_evidence: offense substitutes by play type; dynamic receivers lose early-down snaps for blocking errors

preseason_hypothesis: Miami will use a specialist committee rather than produce a receiver above a 25 percent target share
confirming_evidence: routes and first reads rotate by personnel; no receiver separates; backs and tight ends absorb volume
disconfirming_evidence: one receiver exceeds 25 percent across at least four representative games with full route participation
